tabs.overview: A frac crew runs the pumps, blender, hydration and chemical add from the data van and the units; the wireline crew works at its unit and the tree; flowback hands tend the chokes and tanks; everyone else stays where the job plan puts them. In the Simulator, crew figures stand at the stations and walk between units.
tabs.engineering: Head count by the job plan; shifts and rotations by the company.
tabs.safety: Hi-vis, hard hat, glasses, gloves and FR clothing; nobody inside the red zone while iron is pressured; the head count at muster.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).
